meta.description: Registry for orientation-related failure modes in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: orientation_conflict
failure_modes.description: Competing orientation rules or frames result in unresolvable selection ambiguity.

failure_modes.name: non_unique_minimum
failure_modes.description: Orientation metric results in multiple degenerate minima without a tie-breaking rule.

failure_modes.name: tie_instability
failure_modes.description: Selection erratic switching between degenerate minima under small perturbations.

failure_modes.name: orientation_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Distinct continuation regimes map to identical orientation deviation values.

failure_modes.name: oscillatory_selection
failure_modes.description: Orientation selection results in periodic switching between disparate states.

failure_modes.name: frame_drift
failure_modes.description: Local orientation frame drifts beyond stability boundaries during iteration.

failure_modes.name: metric_undefined
failure_modes.description: Requested orientation metric is not resolved or registered for the current mechanism class.

failure_modes.name: admissibility_minimum_conflict
failure_modes.description: Orientation minimum lies outside the current admissibility window, requiring a constrained minimization.
